description: Diagnose a failed check and draft a contained fix for parent review.

workflows.title: Diagnose and fix a failing check
workflows.prompt: Investigate the failing check I describe. Use the diagnosis and edit-proposal workers when applicable. Propose the smallest fix and show the draft and verification for review.

roles.name: docs-check
roles.description: Check repository excerpts for documentation that no longer matches the code.
roles.instructions: Compare the supplied documentation and code excerpts. Report statements in the documentation that the code contradicts. Cite the documentation line in each finding.
